headline: GIM-UEMOA : 219 620 milliards de FCFA de transactions, la sécurité des paiements au cœur du 9e Salon monétique régional
summary: The 9th GIM-UEMOA regional payments fair opened in Dakar, citing 219,620 billion CFA francs in transactions and 17 billion transactions, according to BCEAO figures.
why: GIM-UEMOA is the interbank payments group for West African Economic and Monetary Union countries, and its volumes reflect regional financial activity.
